scope: Original bilingual, local synthetic-data educational engineering; no offensive or live operational procedures.

courses.title: 網域名稱系統架構
courses.summary: 以分散式命名、快取一致性與驗證鏈串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect distributed naming, cache consistency and validation chains through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 樹狀命名空間：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Hierarchical namespace: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「樹狀命名空間」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For hierarchical namespace, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「樹狀命名空間」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「解析器責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around hierarchical namespace, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resolver responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 比較「樹狀命名空間」與「解析器責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Compare whether evidence for hierarchical namespace and resolver responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: DNSSEC encrypts every name query. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「樹狀命名空間」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for hierarchical namespace. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。
knowledge.textEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「解析器責任」：遞迴解析器代客追查，權威伺服器提供其區域資料。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「樹狀命名空間」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring resolver responsibilities: Recursive resolvers pursue answers; authoritative servers publish their zones. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove hierarchical namespace passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.

quiz.question: 針對「樹狀命名空間」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of hierarchical namespace?
options: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。
DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。
只檢查「解析器責任」，便可取代「樹狀命名空間」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree.
DNSSEC encrypts every name query.
Checking resolver responsibilities alone replaces verification specific to hierarchical namespace.
quiz.explanation: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 相鄰的「解析器責任」有不同責任：遞迴解析器代客追查，權威伺服器提供其區域資料。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Neighboring resolver responsibilities has a different role: Recursive resolvers pursue answers; authoritative servers publish their zones. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 樹狀命名空間：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Hierarchical namespace: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「樹狀命名空間」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For hierarchical namespace, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「解析器責任」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from resolver responsibilities to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 比較「樹狀命名空間」與「解析器責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Compare whether evidence for hierarchical namespace and resolver responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: DNSSEC encrypts every name query. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「樹狀命名空間」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for hierarchical namespace. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

options: 序號供次要伺服器辨識更新，不是實際經過的秒數。
DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。
只檢查「分割視圖」，便可取代「區域序號」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Serials identify updates for secondary servers, not elapsed seconds.
DNSSEC encrypts every name query.
Checking split views alone replaces verification specific to zone serials.
quiz.explanation: 序號供次要伺服器辨識更新，不是實際經過的秒數。 相鄰的「分割視圖」有不同責任：不同解析視圖可回不同答案，除錯必須記錄客戶端視圖。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Serials identify updates for secondary servers, not elapsed seconds. Neighboring split views has a different role: Views may return different answers; diagnosis must record the client view. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 分割視圖：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Split views: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「分割視圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For split views, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「分割視圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：不同解析視圖可回不同答案，除錯必須記錄客戶端視圖。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定名稱，只改委派點的 NS 與 glue 內容。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「DNSSEC 信任鏈」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around split views, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Views may return different answers; diagnosis must record the client view. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep names fixed and change delegation NS/glue consistency. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat dnssec trust chain as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定名稱，只改委派點的 NS 與 glue 內容。 比較「分割視圖」與「DNSSEC 信任鏈」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep names fixed and change delegation NS/glue consistency. Compare whether evidence for split views and dnssec trust chain supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 縮短 TTL 必然降低所有查詢延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Shorter TTL necessarily reduces every query latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分割視圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for split views. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 不同解析視圖可回不同答案，除錯必須記錄客戶端視圖。
knowledge.textEn: Views may return different answers; diagnosis must record the client view.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「DNSSEC 信任鏈」：DS 與 DNSKEY 連接驗證鏈，簽章保護來源與完整性。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「分割視圖」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring dnssec trust chain: DS and DNSKEY connect validation; signatures protect origin and integrity. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove split views passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.textEn: Keep names fixed and change delegation NS/glue consistency. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「平均命中率不能單獨決定排隊或最慢查詢時間。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「更新回滾」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Average hit ratio alone cannot determine queues or worst-case latency. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Hold load fixed and model one authoritative-server outage. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from update rollback to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 比較「容量與尾延遲」與「更新回滾」的證據是否支持相同推論。

steps.failure: 縮短 TTL 必然降低所有查詢延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring hierarchical namespace: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove evidence handoff passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Hold load fixed and model one authoritative-server outage. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.

quiz.question: 針對「證據交接」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of evidence handoff?
options: 可重現查詢需保留名稱、型別、視圖、時間及驗證狀態。
縮短 TTL 必然降低所有查詢延遲。
只檢查「樹狀命名空間」，便可取代「證據交接」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Reproducible queries record name, type, view, time and validation status.
Shorter TTL necessarily reduces every query latency.
Checking hierarchical namespace alone replaces verification specific to evidence handoff.
quiz.explanation: 可重現查詢需保留名稱、型別、視圖、時間及驗證狀態。 相鄰的「樹狀命名空間」有不同責任：域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Reproducible queries record name, type, view, time and validation status. Neighboring hierarchical namespace has a different role: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 時間同步 PTP 網路
courses.summary: 以時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 時鐘域：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Clock domains: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘域」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock domains, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時鐘域」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「四時戳模型」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around clock domains, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat four-timestamp model as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 比較「時鐘域」與「四時戳模型」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Compare whether evidence for clock domains and four-timestamp model supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘域」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock domains. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。
knowledge.textEn: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「四時戳模型」：offset 與延遲的分離需要雙向延遲對稱假設。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「時鐘域」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring four-timestamp model: Separating offset and delay requires a bidirectional symmetry assumption. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove clock domains passes.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 t2−t1=120 ns、t4−t3=80 ns，對稱模型估 offset=(120−80)/2=20 ns、delay=100 ns；若去程多 40 ns，不對稱造成 20 ns 偏差。
knowledge.textEn: With t2−t1=120 ns and t4−t3=80 ns, the symmetric model gives offset=20 ns and delay=100 ns; 40 ns forward-path asymmetry biases offset by 20 ns.

steps.title: 時鐘域：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Clock domains: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘域」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock domains, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「四時戳模型」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from four-timestamp model to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 比較「時鐘域」與「四時戳模型」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Compare whether evidence for clock domains and four-timestamp model supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘域」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock domains. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「伺服器控制」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：伺服增益影響收斂及雜訊放大，不宜只追求最快變化。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Holdover」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around servo control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Servo gains affect convergence and noise amplification, not only speed. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat holdover as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.failure: 所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for servo control. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

伺服增益影響收斂及雜訊放大，不宜只追求最快變化。

Checking holdover alone replaces verification specific to servo control.
Servo gains affect convergence and noise amplification, not only speed.

options: 所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。
profile 限制互通選項，須逐項核對而非只看 PTP 標籤。
只檢查「故障與告警」，便可取代「時鐘 profile」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals.
Profiles constrain interoperability; a PTP label alone is insufficient.
Checking faults and alarms alone replaces verification specific to clock profiles.
quiz.explanation: profile 限制互通選項，須逐項核對而非只看 PTP 標籤。 相鄰的「故障與告警」有不同責任：鎖定旗標不是所有時段的最大 offset 證明。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Profiles constrain interoperability; a PTP label alone is insufficient. Neighboring faults and alarms has a different role: A lock flag does not prove the maximum offset over every interval. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 時鐘 profile：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Clock profiles: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘 profile」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock profiles, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「profile 限制互通選項，須逐項核對而非只看 PTP 標籤。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬 grandmaster 切換與失鎖的時間序列。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「故障與告警」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Profiles constrain interoperability; a PTP label alone is insufficient. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model grandmaster transitions and loss-of-lock sequences. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from faults and alarms to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬 grandmaster 切換與失鎖的時間序列。 比較「時鐘 profile」與「故障與告警」的證據是否支持相同推論。

steps.failure: 所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘 profile」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock profiles. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 故障與告警：架構與原理

Treat time evidence budget as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

courses.title: 時間敏感網路

courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 流量需求合約：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Traffic contracts: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「流量需求合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For traffic contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「流量需求合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時間基準」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for traffic contracts and time reference supports the same inference.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Admission control」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：只有排程資源足夠才接受新增流。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較大訊框阻塞與預先中斷的理想化情境。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「控制平面」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around admission control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: New streams are admitted only when schedule resources suffice. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare large-frame blocking with idealized preemption. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat control plane as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較大訊框阻塞與預先中斷的理想化情境。 比較「Admission control」與「控制平面」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare large-frame blocking with idealized preemption. Compare whether evidence for admission control and control plane supports the same inference.
steps.failure: TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for admission control. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 只有排程資源足夠才接受新增流。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「控制平面」：集中計算或分散設定都必須保持排程與流定義一致。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「Admission control」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring control plane: Centralized or distributed control must keep schedules and stream definitions consistent. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove admission control passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.textEn: Compare large-frame blocking with idealized preemption. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「Admission control」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

只檢查「控制平面」，便可取代「Admission control」的專屬驗證。
只有排程資源足夠才接受新增流。
optionsEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size.
Checking control plane alone replaces verification specific to admission control.
New streams are admitted only when schedule resources suffice.

同步失效時的降階策略要在服務合約中說明。
只檢查「最差情境」，便可取代「時鐘失鎖」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size.
Service contracts must define degraded behavior after synchronization loss.
Checking worst-case cases alone replaces verification specific to clock-loss behavior.
quiz.explanation: 同步失效時的降階策略要在服務合約中說明。 相鄰的「最差情境」有不同責任：平均延遲良好不代表每個截止時間都被滿足。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Service contracts must define degraded behavior after synchronization loss. Neighboring worst-case cases has a different role: Good mean latency does not prove every deadline is met. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 時鐘失鎖：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Clock-loss behavior: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘失鎖」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock-loss behavior, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「同步失效時的降階策略要在服務合約中說明。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「最差情境」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Service contracts must define degraded behavior after synchronization loss. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from worst-case cases to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 比較「時鐘失鎖」與「最差情境」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Compare whether evidence for clock-loss behavior and worst-case cases supports the same inference.
steps.failure: TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘失鎖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock-loss behavior. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 最差情境：架構與原理

courses.title: 無線區域網路企業部署

courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect rf capacity, roaming and enterprise authentication through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型

stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 需求與並行數：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Demand and concurrency: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「需求與並行數」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For demand and concurrency, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「需求與並行數」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏈路預算」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat link budget as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 比較「需求與並行數」與「鏈路預算」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Compare whether evidence for demand and concurrency and link budget supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。

steps.title: 頻道重用：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Channel reuse: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「頻道重用」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For channel reuse, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「頻道重用」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「頻寬取捨」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around channel reuse, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Co-channel APs contend; reuse requires spatial-separation analysis. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat channel-width tradeoffs as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 比較「頻道重用」與「頻寬取捨」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Compare whether evidence for channel reuse and channel-width tradeoffs supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「頻道重用」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for channel reuse. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Co-channel APs contend; reuse requires spatial-separation analysis.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「頻寬取捨」：較寬頻道提高峰值但減少可獨立重用頻道。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「頻道重用」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring channel-width tradeoffs: Wider channels raise peak rates but reduce independently reusable channels. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove channel reuse passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「頻道重用」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of channel reuse?
options: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。
同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。
只檢查「頻寬取捨」，便可取代「頻道重用」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly.
Co-channel APs contend; reuse requires spatial-separation analysis.
Checking channel-width tradeoffs alone replaces verification specific to channel reuse.
quiz.explanation: 同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。 相鄰的「頻寬取捨」有不同責任：較寬頻道提高峰值但減少可獨立重用頻道。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Co-channel APs contend; reuse requires spatial-separation analysis. Neighboring channel-width tradeoffs has a different role: Wider channels raise peak rates but reduce independently reusable channels. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 頻道重用：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Channel reuse: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「頻道重用」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For channel reuse, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「頻寬取捨」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Co-channel APs contend; reuse requires spatial-separation analysis. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from channel-width tradeoffs to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 比較「頻道重用」與「頻寬取捨」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Compare whether evidence for channel reuse and channel-width tradeoffs supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「頻道重用」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for channel reuse. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly.
Checking controller boundaries alone replaces verification specific to ap backhaul.

steps.title: AP 接回網路：對照試驗與證據

steps.objective: 針對「AP 接回網路」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For ap backhaul, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「無線容量可能被交換器上行與 PoE 能力限制。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「控制器邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from controller boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「AP 接回網路」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for ap backhaul. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 控制器邊界：架構與原理

steps.objective: 針對「控制器邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For controller boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「控制器邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：管理集中與資料路徑集中不是同一種架構。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「企業 EAP」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around controller boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Centralized management and centralized data forwarding are different architectures. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat enterprise eap as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 比較「控制器邊界」與「企業 EAP」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Compare whether evidence for controller boundaries and enterprise eap supports the same inference.
steps.failure: RSSI 高即證明 SNR、吞吐及驗證都合格。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「控制器邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for controller boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想同頻域 20 台客戶端各需 2 Mbit/s，共 40 Mbit/s；有效吞吐 80 Mbit/s 的負載約 50%。此為平均容量假設，未保證碰撞、漫遊或 p99。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「訪客生命週期」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：訪客憑據應受有效期、範圍與撤銷限制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較正常與過期伺服器憑證的假想 EAP 驗證。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「漫遊決策」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around guest lifecycle, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Guest credentials need lifetime, scope and revocation limits. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid versus expired EAP server certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat roaming decisions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較正常與過期伺服器憑證的假想 EAP 驗證。 比較「訪客生命週期」與「漫遊決策」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare valid versus expired EAP server certificates. Compare whether evidence for guest lifecycle and roaming decisions supports the same inference.
steps.failure: RSSI 高即證明 SNR、吞吐及驗證都合格。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「訪客生命週期」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for guest lifecycle. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 訪客憑據應受有效期、範圍與撤銷限制。
knowledge.textEn: Guest credentials need lifetime, scope and revocation limits.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「漫遊決策」：客戶端主導漫遊決策，AP 不能保證所有裝置同樣切換。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「訪客生命週期」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring roaming decisions: Clients drive roaming; APs cannot guarantee identical device transitions. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove guest lifecycle passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較正常與過期伺服器憑證的假想 EAP 驗證。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare valid versus expired EAP server certificates. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

只檢查「漫遊決策」，便可取代「訪客生命週期」的專屬驗證。
訪客憑據應受有效期、範圍與撤銷限制。
optionsEn: High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable.
Checking roaming decisions alone replaces verification specific to guest lifecycle.
Guest credentials need lifetime, scope and revocation limits.

options: 訂閱資料與認證交換是相關但不同的責任。
UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。
只檢查「政策控制」，便可取代「訂閱與認證」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Subscription data and authentication exchange are related but distinct responsibilities.
UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions.
Checking policy control alone replaces verification specific to subscription and authentication.
quiz.explanation: 訂閱資料與認證交換是相關但不同的責任。 相鄰的「政策控制」有不同責任：政策將業務要求轉成可執行的 session 約束。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Subscription data and authentication exchange are related but distinct responsibilities. Neighboring policy control has a different role: Policy turns service requirements into enforceable session constraints. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 訂閱與認證：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Subscription and authentication: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「訂閱與認證」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For subscription and authentication, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「訂閱資料與認證交換是相關但不同的責任。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「政策控制」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Subscription data and authentication exchange are related but distinct responsibilities. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from policy control to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 比較「訂閱與認證」與「政策控制」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Compare whether evidence for subscription and authentication and policy control supports the same inference.
steps.failure: UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「訂閱與認證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for subscription and authentication. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 訂閱資料與認證交換是相關但不同的責任。
knowledge.textEn: Subscription data and authentication exchange are related but distinct responsibilities.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「政策控制」：政策將業務要求轉成可執行的 session 約束。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「訂閱與認證」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring policy control: Policy turns service requirements into enforceable session constraints. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove subscription and authentication passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

steps.title: 政策控制：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Policy control: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「政策控制」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For policy control, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「政策控制」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：政策將業務要求轉成可執行的 session 約束。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「PDU session」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around policy control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Policy turns service requirements into enforceable session constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat pdu sessions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 比較「政策控制」與「PDU session」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Compare whether evidence for policy control and pdu sessions supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 容器數量加倍必然讓有狀態核心容量加倍。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「政策控制」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for policy control. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 相鄰的「PDU session」：session 建立成功不代表端到端應用已可用。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「政策控制」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring pdu sessions: Successful session setup does not prove end-to-end application availability. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove policy control passes.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 10,000 用戶各平均 100 kbit/s，UPF 總量為 1 Gbit/s；加 20% 餘裕取 1.2 Gbit/s，未計封裝或尖峰，不能以此推算控制平面容量。
knowledge.textEn: 10,000 users averaging 100 kbit/s require 1 Gbit/s through the UPF; 20% headroom gives 1.2 Gbit/s, excluding encapsulation, peaks and control-plane capacity.

steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around externalized state, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: External state changes consistency/failure modes; it does not solve scaling automatically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid and stale service-registry data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat capacity models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較正常與失效的服務註冊資料。 比較「狀態外置」與「容量模型」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare valid and stale service-registry data. Compare whether evidence for externalized state and capacity models supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

只檢查「容量模型」，便可取代「狀態外置」的專屬驗證。
狀態外置改變一致性與失效模式，不自動解決擴展。
optionsEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity.
Checking capacity models alone replaces verification specific to externalized state.
External state changes consistency/failure modes; it does not solve scaling automatically.

options: 容器數量加倍必然讓有狀態核心容量加倍。
重試須避免同一請求重複建立不一致狀態。
只檢查「互通矩陣」，便可取代「容錯重試」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity.
Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation.
Checking interoperability matrix alone replaces verification specific to fault retries.
quiz.explanation: 重試須避免同一請求重複建立不一致狀態。 相鄰的「互通矩陣」有不同責任：協議版本與支援選項需形成具體矩陣。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation. Neighboring interoperability matrix has a different role: Protocol versions and supported options need an explicit matrix. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 容錯重試：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Fault retries: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「容錯重試」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For fault retries, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「重試須避免同一請求重複建立不一致狀態。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「互通矩陣」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from interoperability matrix to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 比較「容錯重試」與「互通矩陣」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Compare whether evidence for fault retries and interoperability matrix supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 容器數量加倍必然讓有狀態核心容量加倍。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「容錯重試」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for fault retries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

steps.title: 互通矩陣：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Interoperability matrix: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「互通矩陣」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For interoperability matrix, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「互通矩陣」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：協議版本與支援選項需形成具體矩陣。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「服務驗收」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Protocol versions and supported options need an explicit matrix. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service acceptance as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 比較「互通矩陣」與「服務驗收」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Compare whether evidence for interoperability matrix and service acceptance supports the same inference.
steps.failure: UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「互通矩陣」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for interoperability matrix. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

courses.title: 開放式無線接取網路
courses.summary: 以解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 解耦邊界：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Disaggregation boundaries: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「解耦邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For disaggregation boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解耦邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「O-RU 與 O-DU」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around disaggregation boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat o-ru and o-du as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 比較「解耦邊界」與「O-RU 與 O-DU」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Compare whether evidence for disaggregation boundaries and o-ru and o-du supports the same inference.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「加速器介面」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：硬體加速需匹配資料搬移與軟體版本。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較兩供應商能力宣告重疊及缺項。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「安全邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around accelerator interfaces, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceleration needs compatible data movement and software versions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare overlaps and omissions in two vendor capability declarations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat security boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.failureEn: Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Removing a control application should preserve a defined baseline service.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「解耦邊界」：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「降階驗證」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring disaggregation boundaries: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove fallback evidence passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 fronthaul 4 Gbit/s 的教學資料需 10% 額外封裝，鏈路需求為 4.4 Gbit/s；8 Gbit/s 假想可用速率的利用率 55%，未含突發與同步餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed 4 Gbit/s fronthaul traffic with 10% encapsulation needs 4.4 Gbit/s; utilization of an assumed 8 Gbit/s usable link is 55%, excluding bursts and timing margin.

quiz.question: 針對「降階驗證」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of fallback evidence?
options: 應用撤除時應保留可描述的基線服務。
所有 RIC 控制迴路均適合逐 OFDM 符號控制。
只檢查「解耦邊界」，便可取代「降階驗證」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Removing a control application should preserve a defined baseline service.
Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control.
Checking disaggregation boundaries alone replaces verification specific to fallback evidence.
quiz.explanation: 應用撤除時應保留可描述的基線服務。 相鄰的「解耦邊界」有不同責任：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing a control application should preserve a defined baseline service. Neighboring disaggregation boundaries has a different role: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設 fronthaul 4 Gbit/s 的教學資料需 10% 額外封裝，鏈路需求為 4.4 Gbit/s；8 Gbit/s 假想可用速率的利用率 55%，未含突發與同步餘裕。
workedExample.textEn: Assumed 4 Gbit/s fronthaul traffic with 10% encapsulation needs 4.4 Gbit/s; utilization of an assumed 8 Gbit/s usable link is 55%, excluding bursts and timing margin.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 5G 網路切片
courses.summary: 以切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 服務合約：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Service contracts: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「服務合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For service contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「切片識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat slice identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 比較「服務合約」與「切片識別」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Compare whether evidence for service contracts and slice identifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 切片名稱不同便具有物理資源隔離。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different slice names prove physical resource isolation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「服務合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for service contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「切片識別」：切片識別指向服務選擇，不能自行創造隔離。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「服務合約」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring slice identifiers: Identifiers select services; they do not create isolation by themselves. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove service contracts passes.

knowledge.textEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 Gbit/s 鏈路分 40%、30%、20% 給三片，共 900 Mbit/s，保留 100 Mbit/s；共享排隊與 CPU 未隔離時，分配比例不能單獨保證延遲。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 1 Gbit/s link allocates 40%, 30% and 20% to three slices, totaling 900 Mbit/s and leaving 100 Mbit/s; shares alone do not guarantee latency with shared queues/CPU.

quiz.question: 針對「服務合約」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

optionsEn: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements.

steps.title: 服務合約：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Service contracts: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「服務合約」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For service contracts, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「切片識別」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from slice identifiers to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 比較「服務合約」與「切片識別」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Compare whether evidence for service contracts and slice identifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 切片名稱不同便具有物理資源隔離。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different slice names prove physical resource isolation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「服務合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for service contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

courses.title: 蜂巢式基地台整合
courses.summary: 以基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 系統功能圖：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: System functional map: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「系統功能圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For system functional map, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「系統功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「功能切分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around system functional map, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat functional splits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 比較「系統功能圖」與「功能切分」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Compare whether evidence for system functional map and functional splits supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線數直接等於任何位置的可用 MIMO 層數。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Antenna count equals usable MIMO layers at every location. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「系統功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for system functional map. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。
knowledge.textEn: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「功能切分」：切分位置改變傳輸容量與時間限制。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「系統功能圖」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring functional splits: Split placement changes transport-capacity and timing constraints. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove system functional map passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 20 MHz 教學頻寬與 4 bit/s/Hz 有效效率，單層吞吐 80 Mbit/s；假定四層可獨立利用為 320 Mbit/s，此為理想上界，未計協議開銷與實際通道秩。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 20 MHz channel at 4 bit/s/Hz yields 80 Mbit/s per layer; four independent layers imply 320 Mbit/s as an ideal upper bound, excluding overhead and actual channel rank.

quiz.question: 針對「系統功能圖」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of system functional map?
options: 射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。
天線數直接等於任何位置的可用 MIMO 層數。
只檢查「功能切分」，便可取代「系統功能圖」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems.
Antenna count equals usable MIMO layers at every location.
Checking functional splits alone replaces verification specific to system functional map.
quiz.explanation: 射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。 相鄰的「功能切分」有不同責任：切分位置改變傳輸容量與時間限制。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Neighboring functional splits has a different role: Split placement changes transport-capacity and timing constraints. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 系統功能圖：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: System functional map: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「系統功能圖」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For system functional map, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「功能切分」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Evaluate the principle: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from functional splits to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 比較「系統功能圖」與「功能切分」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Compare whether evidence for system functional map and functional splits supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線數直接等於任何位置的可用 MIMO 層數。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Antenna count equals usable MIMO layers at every location. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「系統功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for system functional map. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 交遞邊界：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Handover boundaries: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「交遞邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For handover boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「交遞邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：覆蓋重疊與觸發門檻共同影響交遞中斷。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個同步源中斷後的降階。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「熱與供電」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Model degradation after one timing-source outage. Compare whether evidence for handover boundaries and thermal and power budget supports the same inference.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「OLT 到 ONT」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：feeder、分光及 drop 段決定服務與故障範圍。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改分光比，觀察損耗與共享容量。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「點對點與 PON」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around olt-to-ont topology, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Feeder, splitting and drop segments define service/failure scope. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change split ratio and compare loss/shared capacity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat point-to-point versus pon as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改分光比，觀察損耗與共享容量。 比較「OLT 到 ONT」與「點對點與 PON」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change split ratio and compare loss/shared capacity. Compare whether evidence for olt-to-ont topology and point-to-point versus pon supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 分光器把每個住戶都變成獨立全速鏈路。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A splitter provides an independent full-rate link to every household. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「OLT 到 ONT」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for olt-to-ont topology. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: feeder、分光及 drop 段決定服務與故障範圍。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「點對點與 PON」：專用纖與共享光樹具有不同容量及成本結構。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「OLT 到 ONT」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring point-to-point versus pon: Dedicated fiber and shared trees have different capacity/cost structures. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove olt-to-ont topology passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
