steps.objective: 針對「帶寬配置」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For bandwidth allocation, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較同步與突發住戶負載。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「住戶服務映射」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Demand allocation affects fairness and waiting on shared capacity. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare synchronized and bursty household loads. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from subscriber mapping to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較同步與突發住戶負載。 比較「帶寬配置」與「住戶服務映射」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synchronized and bursty household loads. Compare whether evidence for bandwidth allocation and subscriber mapping supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 光功率高於靈敏度便保證所有上行時隙正常。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Power above sensitivity guarantees every upstream time slot works. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「帶寬配置」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for bandwidth allocation. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。
knowledge.textEn: Demand allocation affects fairness and waiting on shared capacity.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「住戶服務映射」：實體光埠與訂閱服務須保持可追溯映射。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「帶寬配置」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring subscriber mapping: Physical optical ports and subscriptions need traceable mappings. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove bandwidth allocation passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較同步與突發住戶負載。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare synchronized and bursty household loads. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「帶寬配置」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of bandwidth allocation?
options: 需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。
光功率高於靈敏度便保證所有上行時隙正常。
只檢查「住戶服務映射」，便可取代「帶寬配置」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Demand allocation affects fairness and waiting on shared capacity.
Power above sensitivity guarantees every upstream time slot works.
Checking subscriber mapping alone replaces verification specific to bandwidth allocation.
quiz.explanation: 需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。 相鄰的「住戶服務映射」有不同責任：實體光埠與訂閱服務須保持可追溯映射。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Demand allocation affects fairness and waiting on shared capacity. Neighboring subscriber mapping has a different role: Physical optical ports and subscriptions need traceable mappings. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 住戶服務映射：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Subscriber mapping: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「住戶服務映射」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For subscriber mapping, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「住戶服務映射」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：實體光埠與訂閱服務須保持可追溯映射。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較同步與突發住戶負載。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「容量超售」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around subscriber mapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical optical ports and subscriptions need traceable mappings. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synchronized and bursty household loads. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat oversubscription as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較同步與突發住戶負載。 比較「住戶服務映射」與「容量超售」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synchronized and bursty household loads. Compare whether evidence for subscriber mapping and oversubscription supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 分光器把每個住戶都變成獨立全速鏈路。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A splitter provides an independent full-rate link to every household. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「住戶服務映射」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for subscriber mapping. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 放行證據：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「放行證據」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：距離、功率、負載及重啟條件須覆蓋驗收。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 ONT 重新加入而不改其他訂閱。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「設備邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

knowledge.textEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「I/Q 訊號」：正交分量共同表達複數光場資訊。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「相干量測」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring i/q signals: Quadrature components jointly represent complex field information. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove coherent measurement passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 32 GBd、DP-QPSK 共 4 bit/符號，毛速率 128 Gbit/s；20% 以毛速率為分母的開銷後 payload 為 102.4 Gbit/s。忽略成形與實際 FEC。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 32 GBd and DP-QPSK carrying four bits/symbol, gross rate=128 Gbit/s; overhead equal to 20% of gross leaves 102.4 Gbit/s, ignoring shaping and actual FEC.

quiz.question: 針對「相干量測」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of coherent measurement?
options: 本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。
相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。
只檢查「I/Q 訊號」，便可取代「相干量測」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection.
Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit.
Checking i/q signals alone replaces verification specific to coherent measurement.
quiz.explanation: 本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。 相鄰的「I/Q 訊號」有不同責任：正交分量共同表達複數光場資訊。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection. Neighboring i/q signals has a different role: Quadrature components jointly represent complex field information. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: I/Q 訊號：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: I/Q signals: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「I/Q 訊號」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For i/q signals, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「I/Q 訊號」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正交分量共同表達複數光場資訊。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留調變，只改 OSNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「雙偏振」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around i/q signals, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Quadrature components jointly represent complex field information. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat dual polarization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 比較「I/Q 訊號」與「雙偏振」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Compare whether evidence for i/q signals and dual polarization supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「I/Q 訊號」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for i/q signals. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.check: 提交「I/Q 訊號」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

Principle: Wrong sampling instants disturb constellations and equalization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat nonlinear penalties as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

quiz.question: 針對「模式回退」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

Checking coherent measurement alone replaces verification specific to mode fallback.

courses.title: 海底光纜通訊系統
courses.summary: 以海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Wet plant 邊界：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Wet-plant boundaries: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Wet plant 邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For wet-plant boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Wet plant 邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「纜路段數」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around wet-plant boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat span counts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 比較「Wet plant 邊界」與「纜路段數」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Compare whether evidence for wet-plant boundaries and span counts supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 光放大器恢復功率便完全消除先前雜訊。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An optical amplifier restores power and removes all prior noise. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Wet plant 邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for wet-plant boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「維修時間」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：可靠性報告須計入故障率與修復時間。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「復原路由」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat restoration routes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 比較「維修時間」與「復原路由」的證據是否支持相同推論。

兩條海纜名稱不同便沒有共同故障域。
只檢查「Wet plant 邊界」，便可取代「交付證據」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Measurements, route versions and limitations need traceable records.
Different cable names imply no common failure domains.
Checking wet-plant boundaries alone replaces verification specific to delivery evidence.
quiz.explanation: 原始量測、纜路版本及限制需形成可追溯紀錄。 相鄰的「Wet plant 邊界」有不同責任：海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements, route versions and limitations need traceable records. Neighboring wet-plant boundaries has a different role: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 交付證據：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Delivery evidence: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「交付證據」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For delivery evidence, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「原始量測、纜路版本及限制需形成可追溯紀錄。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「Wet plant 邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Measurements, route versions and limitations need traceable records. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from wet-plant boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 比較「交付證據」與「Wet plant 邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Compare whether evidence for delivery evidence and wet-plant boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 兩條海纜名稱不同便沒有共同故障域。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different cable names imply no common failure domains. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交付證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for delivery evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 原始量測、纜路版本及限制需形成可追溯紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements, route versions and limitations need traceable records.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「Wet plant 邊界」：海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「交付證據」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring wet-plant boundaries: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove delivery evidence passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬一段停用對冗餘路由的服務影響。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model service effects of one disabled segment under redundant routing. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 6000 km 路線以 80 km 段切分，共 75 段；若每段損耗 16 dB，不能直接把 1200 dB 當作端到端淨損耗，因中間有放大且逐段累加雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 6000 km route at 80 km per span has 75 spans; 75×16=1200 dB is not net end-to-end loss when intermediate amplification restores signal and adds noise.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想 6000 km 路線以 80 km 段切分，共 75 段；若每段損耗 16 dB，不能直接把 1200 dB 當作端到端淨損耗，因中間有放大且逐段累加雜訊。

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 衛星地面站通訊鏈路
courses.summary: 以衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 任務資料流：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Mission data flows: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「任務資料流」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For mission data flows, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「任務資料流」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「軌道與可見性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission data flows, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat orbit and visibility as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 比較「任務資料流」與「軌道與可見性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for mission data flows and orbit and visibility supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「任務資料流」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for mission data flows. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring orbit and visibility: Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove mission data flows passes.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 GHz、1000 km 自由空間，FSPL=92.45+20log10(2)+20log10(1000)=158.47 dB；EIRP 50 dBW、接收增益 30 dBi、其他損失 2 dB，接收約 −80.47 dBW。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2 GHz over 1000 km: FSPL=158.47 dB; EIRP=50 dBW, receive gain=30 dBi and other losses=2 dB give approximately −80.47 dBW.

options: 天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。
軌道幾何決定可見窗口與斜距。
只檢查「自由空間損失」，便可取代「軌道與可見性」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Sufficient antenna gain eliminates Doppler tracking needs.
Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range.
Checking free-space loss alone replaces verification specific to orbit and visibility.
quiz.explanation: 軌道幾何決定可見窗口與斜距。 相鄰的「自由空間損失」有不同責任：FSPL 以距離及頻率的平方尺度增加。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range. Neighboring free-space loss has a different role: FSPL increases with squared distance and frequency scales. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 軌道與可見性：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Orbit and visibility: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「軌道與可見性」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For orbit and visibility, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「軌道幾何決定可見窗口與斜距。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「自由空間損失」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Orbital geometry determines visibility windows and slant range. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from free-space loss to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 比較「軌道與可見性」與「自由空間損失」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for orbit and visibility and free-space loss supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Sufficient antenna gain eliminates Doppler tracking needs. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「軌道與可見性」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for orbit and visibility. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 自由空間損失：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Free-space loss: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「自由空間損失」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For free-space loss, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「自由空間損失」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：FSPL 以距離及頻率的平方尺度增加。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「EIRP」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: FSPL increases with squared distance and frequency scales. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat effective radiated power as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Compare whether evidence for free-space loss and effective radiated power supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「自由空間損失」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.title: 接收 G/T：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「接收 G/T」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：天線增益與系統雜訊溫度共同決定接收品質。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定距離，只改視線向相對速度。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「指向誤差」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 本課僅分析公開模型，不發射或操作真實衛星。
knowledge.textEn: This course analyzes public models without transmitting or operating satellites.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「任務資料流」：遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「授權邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring mission data flows: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove authorization boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬縮短接觸窗口對可傳資料量的影響。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model reduced contact-window duration and transferable data. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 GHz、1000 km 自由空間，FSPL=92.45+20log10(2)+20log10(1000)=158.47 dB；EIRP 50 dBW、接收增益 30 dBi、其他損失 2 dB，接收約 −80.47 dBW。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2 GHz over 1000 km: FSPL=158.47 dB; EIRP=50 dBW, receive gain=30 dBi and other losses=2 dB give approximately −80.47 dBW.

quiz.question: 針對「授權邊界」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of authorization boundaries?
options: 本課僅分析公開模型，不發射或操作真實衛星。
天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。
只檢查「任務資料流」，便可取代「授權邊界」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: This course analyzes public models without transmitting or operating satellites.
Sufficient antenna gain eliminates Doppler tracking needs.
Checking mission data flows alone replaces verification specific to authorization boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 本課僅分析公開模型，不發射或操作真實衛星。 相鄰的「任務資料流」有不同責任：遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This course analyzes public models without transmitting or operating satellites. Neighboring mission data flows has a different role: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。

courses.title: 低軌衛星網路路由
courses.summary: 以時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect time-varying topology, handover and intersatellite routing through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 星座圖：架構與原理

steps.objective: 針對「星座圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For constellation graph, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「星座圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：節點位置與鏈路可用性都隨時間變化。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留星座，只改路徑代價權重。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「星間與地面邊」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around constellation graph, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Node positions and link availability both vary over time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat space and ground edges as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留星座，只改路徑代價權重。 比較「星座圖」與「星間與地面邊」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Compare whether evidence for constellation graph and space and ground edges supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 最少跳數必然是最小延遲路徑。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Fewest hops necessarily means minimum latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「星座圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for constellation graph. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想路徑四段各 1000 km 真空傳播，以 c≈300000 km/s，單向 13.33 ms；每跳處理 0.5 ms 四次加 2 ms，合為 15.33 ms，未計接取與排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Four hypothetical 1000 km vacuum segments give 13.33 ms one-way at c≈300000 km/s; four 0.5 ms processing delays add 2 ms, totaling 15.33 ms before access/queuing.

steps.title: 接觸預測：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「接觸預測」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：已知軌道可預測窗口，但設備與天候仍可能偏離。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定負載，只移除單一星間邊。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「交遞排程」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix load and remove one intersatellite edge. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat handover schedules as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.title: 故障繞路：架構與原理

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制

workedExample.text: 假想路徑四段各 1000 km 真空傳播，以 c≈300000 km/s，單向 13.33 ms；每跳處理 0.5 ms 四次加 2 ms，合為 15.33 ms，未計接取與排隊。
workedExample.textEn: Four hypothetical 1000 km vacuum segments give 13.33 ms one-way at c≈300000 km/s; four 0.5 ms processing delays add 2 ms, totaling 15.33 ms before access/queuing.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 深空延遲容忍網路
courses.summary: 以儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: DTN 覆疊層：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: DTN overlay: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「DTN 覆疊層」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For dtn overlay, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「DTN 覆疊層」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Bundle 結構」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around dtn overlay, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat bundle structure as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 比較「DTN 覆疊層」與「Bundle 結構」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Compare whether evidence for dtn overlay and bundle structure supports the same inference.
steps.failure: Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「DTN 覆疊層」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for dtn overlay. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。
knowledge.textEn: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「Bundle 結構」：bundle 結合資料及跨延遲處理所需 metadata。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「DTN 覆疊層」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring bundle structure: Bundles combine data with metadata needed across delayed handling. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove dtn overlay passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 4 Mbit/s 接觸 600 s，可搬 2.4 Gbit=300 MB（十進位）；若每天產生 500 MB，且僅有一次接觸，至少累積 200 MB/日，未計開銷。
knowledge.textEn: A 4 Mbit/s contact lasting 600 s carries 2.4 Gbit=300 MB decimal; generating 500 MB/day with one daily contact grows backlog by at least 200 MB/day before overhead.

quiz.question: 針對「DTN 覆疊層」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of dtn overlay?
options: DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。
Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。
只檢查「Bundle 結構」，便可取代「DTN 覆疊層」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service.
Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer.
Checking bundle structure alone replaces verification specific to dtn overlay.
quiz.explanation: DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。 相鄰的「Bundle 結構」有不同責任：bundle 結合資料及跨延遲處理所需 metadata。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service. Neighboring bundle structure has a different role: Bundles combine data with metadata needed across delayed handling. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: DTN 覆疊層：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: DTN overlay: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「DTN 覆疊層」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For dtn overlay, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「Bundle 結構」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from bundle structure to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 比較「DTN 覆疊層」與「Bundle 結構」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Compare whether evidence for dtn overlay and bundle structure supports the same inference.
steps.failure: Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「DTN 覆疊層」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for dtn overlay. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「儲存攜帶」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分片與重組」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around store-carry behavior, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fragmentation/reassembly as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 比較「儲存攜帶」與「分片與重組」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Compare whether evidence for store-carry behavior and fragmentation/reassembly supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DTN 每一跳都必須與源端同時在線。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every DTN hop must be online simultaneously with the source. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「儲存攜帶」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for store-carry behavior. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。
knowledge.textEn: Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「分片與重組」：分片需保持識別與順序資訊以正確重組。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「儲存攜帶」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring fragmentation/reassembly: Fragments need identifying/order information for correct reassembly. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove store-carry behavior passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 4 Mbit/s 接觸 600 s，可搬 2.4 Gbit=300 MB（十進位）；若每天產生 500 MB，且僅有一次接觸，至少累積 200 MB/日，未計開銷。
knowledge.textEn: A 4 Mbit/s contact lasting 600 s carries 2.4 Gbit=300 MB decimal; generating 500 MB/day with one daily contact grows backlog by at least 200 MB/day before overhead.

節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。
只檢查「分片與重組」，便可取代「儲存攜帶」的專屬驗證。

Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path.
Checking fragmentation/reassembly alone replaces verification specific to store-carry behavior.

steps.title: 時基限制：架構與原理

Model intermediary restart with preserved versus lost persistent data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想撤銷同步需 30 s、授權快取最長 60 s，最差残留許可窗口可達 90 s；此為兩延遲相加的保守假設，不表示任何實作都採此值。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed revocation propagation of 30 s plus 60 s authorization caching gives a conservative possible 90 s residual-access window; these are not implementation defaults.

quiz.question: 針對「資源盤點」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of resource inventory?
options: 先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。
內網位址足以證明應授予存取。
只檢查「主體身分」，便可取代「資源盤點」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy.
An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement.
Checking subject identities alone replaces verification specific to resource inventory.
quiz.explanation: 先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。 相鄰的「主體身分」有不同責任：人、服務及裝置身分需要各自生命週期。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Neighboring subject identities has a different role: People, services and devices need distinct identity lifecycles. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 資源盤點：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Resource inventory: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「資源盤點」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For resource inventory, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「主體身分」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from subject identities to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 比較「資源盤點」與「主體身分」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Compare whether evidence for resource inventory and subject identities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 內網位址足以證明應授予存取。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資源盤點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for resource inventory. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 相鄰的「主體身分」：人、服務及裝置身分需要各自生命週期。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「資源盤點」已通過。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

只檢查「遷移驗收」，便可取代「合成政策測試」的專屬驗證。
允許與拒絕樣本都需要驗證。
optionsEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement.
Checking migration acceptance alone replaces verification specific to synthetic policy tests.
Validate both allowed and denied synthetic cases.
quiz.explanation: 允許與拒絕樣本都需要驗證。 相鄰的「遷移驗收」有不同責任：逐資源遷移需確認舊旁路也被關閉。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Validate both allowed and denied synthetic cases. Neighboring migration acceptance has a different role: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 遷移驗收：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Migration acceptance: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「遷移驗收」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For migration acceptance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「遷移驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：逐資源遷移需確認舊旁路也被關閉。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「資源盤點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around migration acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resource inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 比較「遷移驗收」與「資源盤點」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Compare whether evidence for migration acceptance and resource inventory supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 零信任等於每個請求都要求使用者手動再登入。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Zero trust means manual login on every request. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「遷移驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for migration acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 逐資源遷移需確認舊旁路也被關閉。
knowledge.textEn: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「資源盤點」：先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「遷移驗收」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring resource inventory: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove migration acceptance passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想撤銷同步需 30 s、授權快取最長 60 s，最差残留許可窗口可達 90 s；此為兩延遲相加的保守假設，不表示任何實作都採此值。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed revocation propagation of 30 s plus 60 s authorization caching gives a conservative possible 90 s residual-access window; these are not implementation defaults.

steps.objective: 針對「遷移驗收」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For migration acceptance, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「逐資源遷移需確認舊旁路也被關閉。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「資源盤點」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from resource inventory to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 比較「遷移驗收」與「資源盤點」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Compare whether evidence for migration acceptance and resource inventory supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 零信任等於每個請求都要求使用者手動再登入。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Zero trust means manual login on every request. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「遷移驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for migration acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想撤銷同步需 30 s、授權快取最長 60 s，最差残留許可窗口可達 90 s；此為兩延遲相加的保守假設，不表示任何實作都採此值。
workedExample.textEn: Assumed revocation propagation of 30 s plus 60 s authorization caching gives a conservative possible 90 s residual-access window; these are not implementation defaults.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 身分與存取管理
courses.summary: 以身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 身分證明：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Identity proofing: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「身分證明」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For identity proofing, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「身分證明」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：聲稱身分與驗證聲稱的證據需要分開。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改角色集合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around identity proofing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat stable identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定使用者，只改角色集合。 比較「身分證明」與「唯一識別」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix users and vary role sets. Compare whether evidence for identity proofing and stable identifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 驗證成功自動授予所有資源權限。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Successful authentication automatically grants every resource. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「身分證明」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for identity proofing. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 聲稱身分與驗證聲稱的證據需要分開。
knowledge.textEn: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「唯一識別」：不可變識別碼避免改名造成權限混淆。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「身分證明」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring stable identifiers: Immutable identifiers prevent rename-related authorization confusion. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove identity proofing passes.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 2000 人各 8 個直接權限關係共有 16000 邊；若 20 角色各 30 權限並每人 2 角色，需 600+4000=4600 邊，但角色設計仍可能過度授權。
knowledge.textEn: 2000 people with eight direct grants create 16000 edges; 20 roles with 30 grants plus two roles/person create 4600 edges, but role design may still overgrant.

steps.title: 角色模型：架構與原理

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.title: 职責分離：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「復原邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：帳號復原不可成為較弱的長期登入旁路。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬身分提供者失效後的受控恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「審計隱私」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Model controlled recovery after identity-provider failure. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit privacy as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.title: 因子分類：架構與原理

steps.title: Challenge 新鮮度：架構與原理

steps.objective: 針對「Challenge 新鮮度」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For challenge freshness, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Challenge 新鮮度」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：挑战應關聯當前请求並防止重放。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定帳號，只改 challenge 新鮮度。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「WebAuthn 範圍」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around challenge freshness, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Challenges bind current requests and prevent replay. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat webauthn scope as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定帳號，只改 challenge 新鮮度。 比較「Challenge 新鮮度」與「WebAuthn 範圍」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Compare whether evidence for challenge freshness and webauthn scope supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Challenge 新鮮度」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for challenge freshness. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 挑战應關聯當前请求並防止重放。
knowledge.textEn: Challenges bind current requests and prevent replay.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「WebAuthn 範圍」：公鑰憑據受 RP 範圍限制。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「Challenge 新鮮度」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring webauthn scope: Public-key credentials are scoped to relying parties. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove challenge freshness passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定帳號，只改 challenge 新鮮度。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「Challenge 新鮮度」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of challenge freshness?
options: 密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。
挑战應關聯當前请求並防止重放。
只檢查「WebAuthn 範圍」，便可取代「Challenge 新鮮度」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication.
Challenges bind current requests and prevent replay.
Checking webauthn scope alone replaces verification specific to challenge freshness.
quiz.explanation: 挑战應關聯當前请求並防止重放。 相鄰的「WebAuthn 範圍」有不同責任：公鑰憑據受 RP 範圍限制。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Challenges bind current requests and prevent replay. Neighboring webauthn scope has a different role: Public-key credentials are scoped to relying parties. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: Challenge 新鮮度：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Challenge freshness: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「Challenge 新鮮度」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For challenge freshness, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「挑战應關聯當前请求並防止重放。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定帳號，只改 challenge 新鮮度。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「WebAuthn 範圍」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Challenges bind current requests and prevent replay. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from webauthn scope to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定帳號，只改 challenge 新鮮度。 比較「Challenge 新鮮度」與「WebAuthn 範圍」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix account and vary challenge freshness. Compare whether evidence for challenge freshness and webauthn scope supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Challenge 新鮮度」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for challenge freshness. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring device binding: Device-bound and synchronized credentials offer different tradeoffs. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove synced passkeys passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較正確與錯誤 RP ID 的合成記錄。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare synthetic records with correct/incorrect RP IDs. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「同步 passkey」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of synced passkeys?
options: 密碼加另一個密碼必定是雙因素。
只檢查「裝置绑定」，便可取代「同步 passkey」的專屬驗證。
同步改善復原選項，也引入同步帳號邊界。
optionsEn: A password plus another password is necessarily two-factor authentication.
Checking device binding alone replaces verification specific to synced passkeys.
Sync improves recovery options and introduces sync-account boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 同步改善復原選項，也引入同步帳號邊界。 相鄰的「裝置绑定」有不同責任：裝置绑定與跨裝置同步提供不同部署取捨。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Sync improves recovery options and introduces sync-account boundaries. Neighboring device binding has a different role: Device-bound and synchronized credentials offer different tradeoffs. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 裝置绑定：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Device binding: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「裝置绑定」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For device binding, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置绑定」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：裝置绑定與跨裝置同步提供不同部署取捨。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較正確與錯誤 RP ID 的合成記錄。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「伺服器儲存」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device binding, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Device-bound and synchronized credentials offer different tradeoffs. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic records with correct/incorrect RP IDs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat server storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較正確與錯誤 RP ID 的合成記錄。 比較「裝置绑定」與「伺服器儲存」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic records with correct/incorrect RP IDs. Compare whether evidence for device binding and server storage supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有 OTP 都具備抗網釣性。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every OTP method is phishing-resistant. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置绑定」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device binding. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.objectiveEn: For device binding, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「裝置绑定與跨裝置同步提供不同部署取捨。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較正確與錯誤 RP ID 的合成記錄。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「伺服器儲存」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Device-bound and synchronized credentials offer different tradeoffs. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare synthetic records with correct/incorrect RP IDs. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from server storage to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.check: 提交「裝置绑定」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設六位數等機率碼為 1000000 種，最多 5 次猜測的成功率上界 5/1000000=0.0005%；未考慮被竊取、重放或有偏分布，不能據此評估整體 MFA 安全。
workedExample.textEn: A uniform six-digit code has 1000000 values; five guesses bound success at 0.0005%, excluding theft, replay and biased generation and not measuring total MFA security.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 公鑰基礎建設
courses.summary: 以信任錨、憑證路徑與撤銷串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect trust anchors, certificate paths and revocation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 信任锚：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Trust anchors: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「信任锚」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For trust anchors, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「信任锚」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「根與中繼」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around trust anchors, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat roots and intermediates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 比較「信任锚」與「根與中繼」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Compare whether evidence for trust anchors and roots and intermediates supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 鏈上簽章都正確便不需检查名稱與用途。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任锚」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for trust anchors. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。
knowledge.textEn: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「根與中繼」：中繼限制簽發責任並降低根鍵使用頻率。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「信任锚」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring roots and intermediates: Intermediates scope issuance and reduce root-key use. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove trust anchors passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想根→中繼→葉三張憑證，驗證兩個非自簽鏈邊各需 1.2 ms，合為 2.4 ms；還需名稱、用途、時間、撤銷检驗，不能把它當成總 TLS 握手時间。
knowledge.textEn: A root→intermediate→leaf path with two non-self-signed edges at 1.2 ms verification each costs 2.4 ms, excluding name, usage, time, revocation checks and total TLS handshake time.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of trust anchors?

鏈上簽章都正確便不需检查名稱與用途。
只檢查「根與中繼」，便可取代「信任锚」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone.
Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks.
Checking roots and intermediates alone replaces verification specific to trust anchors.
quiz.explanation: 信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。 相鄰的「根與中繼」有不同責任：中繼限制簽發責任並降低根鍵使用頻率。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。

steps.objective: 針對「信任锚」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。

steps.failureEn: Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任锚」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「葉憑證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：葉證書將主體、用途及公鑰關聯。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「路徑建構」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat path building as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. steps.title: 簽發稽核：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「簽發稽核」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：簽發请求與批准證據應關聯具體版本。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬中繼撤銷對下層叶證書的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏈更新」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

steps.check: 提交「簽發稽核」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring capacity and queues: End-to-end delay includes API, network and module queues. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove key wrapping passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定请求率，只改 API 延遲。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix request rate and vary API latency. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「密鑰包裝」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of key wrapping?
options: 包裝保護搬移資料，也須明確導出策略。
FIPS 驗證表示任意部署配置都已獲驗證。
只檢查「容量與排隊」，便可取代「密鑰包裝」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Wrapping protects transported material and needs explicit export policy.
FIPS validation certifies every possible deployment configuration.
Checking capacity and queues alone replaces verification specific to key wrapping.
quiz.explanation: 包裝保護搬移資料，也須明確導出策略。 相鄰的「容量與排隊」有不同責任：端到端延遲包括 API、網絡及模塊隊列。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrapping protects transported material and needs explicit export policy. Neighboring capacity and queues has a different role: End-to-end delay includes API, network and module queues. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 容量與排隊：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Capacity and queues: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「容量與排隊」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For capacity and queues, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「容量與排隊」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端到端延遲包括 API、網絡及模塊隊列。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定请求率，只改 API 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「高可用」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around capacity and queues, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: End-to-end delay includes API, network and module queues. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix request rate and vary API latency. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat high availability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定请求率，只改 API 延遲。 比較「容量與排隊」與「高可用」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix request rate and vary API latency. Compare whether evidence for capacity and queues and high availability supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「容量與排隊」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for capacity and queues. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from high availability to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.check: 提交「容量與排隊」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「熵與生成」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：鍵材需要合適隨機來源，不等於可預測编號。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分發通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entropy and generation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distribution channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 比較「熵與生成」與「分發通道」的證據是否支持相同推論。

steps.failure: 加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring distribution channels: Key distribution must preserve origin and confidentiality. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove entropy and generation passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。
只檢查「分發通道」，便可取代「熵與生成」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers.
Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery.
Checking distribution channels alone replaces verification specific to entropy and generation.

steps.title: 輪替範圍：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「銷毁證明」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：刪除索引不等於所有備份秘密已被清除。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「資產關聯」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

courses.title: TLS 憑證自動化
courses.summary: 以域名授權、憑證續期與部署一致性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
