knowledge.textEn: Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「CSR 與鍵」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of csr and keys?
options: 取得憑證等於取得網站全部業務授權。
只檢查「名稱覆盖」，便可取代「CSR 與鍵」的專屬驗證。
CSR 请求關聯公鑰；私鍵應保持受控。
optionsEn: Obtaining a certificate grants all website business permissions.
Checking name coverage alone replaces verification specific to csr and keys.
CSRs associate public keys; private keys remain controlled.
quiz.explanation: CSR 请求關聯公鑰；私鍵應保持受控。 相鄰的「名稱覆盖」有不同責任：憑證的名稱範圍必須與部署服務一致。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: CSRs associate public keys; private keys remain controlled. Neighboring name coverage has a different role: Certificate names must match deployed services. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 名稱覆盖：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Name coverage: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「名稱覆盖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For name coverage, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「名稱覆盖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：憑證的名稱範圍必須與部署服務一致。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較已簽發但未部署與已部署憑證。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「憑證鏈」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around name coverage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Certificate names must match deployed services. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat certificate chains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較已簽發但未部署與已部署憑證。 比較「名稱覆盖」與「憑證鏈」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Compare whether evidence for name coverage and certificate chains supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 簽發成功表示所有服務節點已更新。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Successful issuance proves every service node is updated. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「名稱覆盖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for name coverage. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 風險時間線：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Risk timelines: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「風險時間線」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For risk timelines, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「風險時間線」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：長保存秘密需考慮今天收集未來解密風險。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定安全目標，只改 KEM 與簽章用途。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「密碼盤點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around risk timelines, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Long-lived secrets need harvest-now/decrypt-later risk analysis. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cryptographic inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定安全目標，只改 KEM 與簽章用途。 比較「風險時間線」與「密碼盤點」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Compare whether evidence for risk timelines and cryptographic inventory supports the same inference.
steps.failure: ML-KEM 直接提供任意長度資料的數字簽章。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: ML-KEM directly signs arbitrary-length data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「風險時間線」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for risk timelines. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。
knowledge.textEn: ML-KEM-768 has a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertext, totaling 2272 bytes of key-establishment material. They normally travel in different directions/messages, not one IP packet; each alone is below an assumed 1500-byte MTU. Evaluate actual message framing and distinguish MTU from TCP MSS.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。
knowledge.textEn: ML-KEM-768 has a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertext, totaling 2272 bytes of key-establishment material. They normally travel in different directions/messages, not one IP packet; each alone is below an assumed 1500-byte MTU. Evaluate actual message framing and distinguish MTU from TCP MSS.

steps.objective: 針對「標準更新」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For standard updates, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「正式部署須核對勘誤與固定版本文件。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬不支持新格式客戶端的受控遷移。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「風險時間線」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Production checks errata and pinned document versions. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from risk timelines to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬不支持新格式客戶端的受控遷移。 比較「標準更新」與「風險時間線」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Compare whether evidence for standard updates and risk timelines supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 使用後量子演算法就自動排除實作侧信道。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Post-quantum algorithms automatically remove implementation side channels. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「標準更新」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for standard updates. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 正式部署須核對勘誤與固定版本文件。
knowledge.textEn: Production checks errata and pinned document versions.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「風險時間線」：長保存秘密需考慮今天收集未來解密風險。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「標準更新」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring risk timelines: Long-lived secrets need harvest-now/decrypt-later risk analysis. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove standard updates passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬不支持新格式客戶端的受控遷移。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。
knowledge.textEn: ML-KEM-768 has a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertext, totaling 2272 bytes of key-establishment material. They normally travel in different directions/messages, not one IP packet; each alone is below an assumed 1500-byte MTU. Evaluate actual message framing and distinguish MTU from TCP MSS.

quiz.question: 針對「標準更新」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of standard updates?
options: 正式部署須核對勘誤與固定版本文件。
使用後量子演算法就自動排除實作侧信道。
只檢查「風險時間線」，便可取代「標準更新」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Production checks errata and pinned document versions.
Post-quantum algorithms automatically remove implementation side channels.
Checking risk timelines alone replaces verification specific to standard updates.
quiz.explanation: 正式部署須核對勘誤與固定版本文件。 相鄰的「風險時間線」有不同責任：長保存秘密需考慮今天收集未來解密風險。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Production checks errata and pinned document versions. Neighboring risk timelines has a different role: Long-lived secrets need harvest-now/decrypt-later risk analysis. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 安全電子郵件閘道
courses.summary: 以郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Envelope 與 From：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Envelope and From: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Envelope 與 From」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For envelope and from, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Envelope 與 From」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：傳輸寄件身分與可見 From 可能不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「SPF 邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around envelope and from, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transport sender identity can differ from visible From. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat spf boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 比較「Envelope 與 From」與「SPF 邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Compare whether evidence for envelope and from and spf boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: SPF 通過表示郵件所有內容必定安全。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: SPF pass proves all message content safe. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Envelope 與 From」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for envelope and from. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每日 10000 封、100 封惡意；規則偵測 90 封且誤標正常信 99 封，precision=90/(90+99)=47.62%，recall=90%。高 recall 仍可能有大量誤攔。
knowledge.textEn: Of 10000 hypothetical messages, 100 malicious, detecting 90 with 99 benign false alarms gives precision=47.62% and recall=90%; high recall can coexist with many false blocks.

DKIM pass always means alignment with visible From.
Checking envelope and from alone replaces verification specific to acceptance datasets.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想每日 10000 封、100 封惡意；規則偵測 90 封且誤標正常信 99 封，precision=90/(90+99)=47.62%，recall=90%。高 recall 仍可能有大量誤攔。
workedExample.textEn: Of 10000 hypothetical messages, 100 malicious, detecting 90 with 99 benign false alarms gives precision=47.62% and recall=90%; high recall can coexist with many false blocks.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 安全網頁應用程式防護
courses.summary: 以應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 應用資產：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Application assets: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「應用資產」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For application assets, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「應用資產」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「信任邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around application assets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 比較「應用資產」與「信任邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Compare whether evidence for application assets and trust boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「應用資產」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for application assets. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。
knowledge.textEn: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「信任邊界」：跨邊界輸入須依格式與用途驗證。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「應用資產」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring trust boundaries: Boundary-crossing input needs format/purpose validation. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove application assets passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每秒 2000 請求，每請求純檢查消耗平均 0.4 ms CPU 時間（不是含等待的經過時間），需求為 0.8 CPU-s/s；單核心理想利用率 80%，未計 TLS、排隊與多執行緒額外成本。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2000 requests/s and 0.4 ms CPU time per inspection, not elapsed time including waits: demand is 0.8 CPU-s/s, an ideal 80% single-core load before TLS, queues and additional threading costs.

steps.check: 提交「應用資產」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.objective: 針對「規則範圍」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For rule scopes, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「每條規則需要適用路徑與內容型別。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「異常分數」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Each rule needs applicable paths and content types. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from anomaly scores to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 比較「規則範圍」與「異常分數」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Compare whether evidence for rule scopes and anomaly scores supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「規則範圍」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rule scopes. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 每條規則需要適用路徑與內容型別。
knowledge.textEn: Each rule needs applicable paths and content types.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「異常分數」：分數門檻是判定策略，不是攻擊成功機率。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「規則範圍」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring anomaly scores: Score thresholds are decision policies, not attack-success probabilities. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove rule scopes passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「規則範圍」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of rule scopes?
options: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。
每條規則需要適用路徑與內容型別。
只檢查「異常分數」，便可取代「規則範圍」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization.
Each rule needs applicable paths and content types.
Checking anomaly scores alone replaces verification specific to rule scopes.
quiz.explanation: 每條規則需要適用路徑與內容型別。 相鄰的「異常分數」有不同責任：分數門檻是判定策略，不是攻擊成功機率。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Each rule needs applicable paths and content types. Neighboring anomaly scores has a different role: Score thresholds are decision policies, not attack-success probabilities. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 異常分數：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Anomaly scores: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「異常分數」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For anomaly scores, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「異常分數」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：分數門檻是判定策略，不是攻擊成功機率。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「False positive」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around anomaly scores, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Score thresholds are decision policies, not attack-success probabilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat false positives as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較有與沒有來源端授權檢查的本地模型。 比較「異常分數」與「False positive」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare local models with/without origin authorization. Compare whether evidence for anomaly scores and false positives supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加拒絕率必然代表安全性提高。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher rejection rates necessarily mean greater security. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異常分數」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for anomaly scores. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 檢測與封鎖：架構與原理

courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 端點覆蓋：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Endpoint coverage: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「端點覆蓋」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For endpoint coverage, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「端點覆蓋」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：感測器缺失會產生不可觀測區域。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改程序父子關係。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「程序事件」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around endpoint coverage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Missing sensors create unobservable regions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary parent-child relationships. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat process events as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改程序父子關係。 比較「端點覆蓋」與「程序事件」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary parent-child relationships. Compare whether evidence for endpoint coverage and process events supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 沒有告警即可證明端點沒有異常。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: No alerts prove an endpoint has no anomalies. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「端點覆蓋」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for endpoint coverage. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 感測器缺失會產生不可觀測區域。
knowledge.textEn: Missing sensors create unobservable regions.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「程序事件」：程序名稱需搭配路徑、父節點與身分。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「端點覆蓋」已通過。

quiz.question: 針對「行為脈絡」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

steps.title: 行為脈絡：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Behavior context: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「行為脈絡」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For behavior context, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「同一操作在管理與異常情境可有不同意義。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較感測器啟用與離線時的證據缺口。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「技術映射」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: The same action can mean different things in administrative/anomalous contexts. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare evidence gaps with active/offline sensors. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from technique mapping to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較感測器啟用與離線時的證據缺口。 比較「行為脈絡」與「技術映射」的證據是否支持相同推論。

steps.failure: ATT&CK 技術名稱本身就是可執行的偵測規則。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An ATT&CK technique name is itself an executable detection rule. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「行為脈絡」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for behavior context. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Compare evidence gaps with active/offline sensors. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.titleEn: Response acceptance: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「回應驗收」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For response acceptance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「回應驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：需驗證偵測、決策、核准與恢復全鏈。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬核准隔離後的服務影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「端點覆蓋」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around response acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Verify detection, decision, approval and recovery end to end. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat endpoint coverage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬核准隔離後的服務影響。 比較「回應驗收」與「端點覆蓋」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model service impact after approved endpoint isolation. Compare whether evidence for response acceptance and endpoint coverage supports the same inference.
steps.failure: ATT&CK 技術名稱本身就是可執行的偵測規則。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An ATT&CK technique name is itself an executable detection rule. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「回應驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for response acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界

steps.failureEn: An ATT&CK technique name is itself an executable detection rule. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「回應驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.

courses.title: 安全資訊事件管理
courses.summary: 以日誌正規化、事件關聯與可用性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect log normalization, event correlation and availability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

quiz.question: 針對「復原驗收」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of recovery acceptance?
options: 回補須檢查遺漏、重複與原始時間。
相同顯示名稱一定代表同一主體。
只檢查「來源盤點」，便可取代「復原驗收」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Backfill checks missing data, duplicates and original timestamps.
Matching display names always identify the same subject.
Checking source inventory alone replaces verification specific to recovery acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 回補須檢查遺漏、重複與原始時間。 相鄰的「來源盤點」有不同責任：事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill checks missing data, duplicates and original timestamps. Neighboring source inventory has a different role: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想每日 100 GB 原始事件，保留 30 日得 3 TB；兩複本得 6 TB，若索引另外 20% 得 7.2 TB；未計壓縮，容量假設須逐項標示。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 100 GB/day for 30 days: 3 TB raw; two replicas require 6 TB, plus 20% indexing gives 7.2 TB before compression, with all assumptions explicit.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

courses.title: 網路入侵偵測工程
courses.summary: 以網路可觀察性、協議解碼與告警品質串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 觀察點：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Observation points: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「觀察點」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For observation points, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「觀察點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏡像完整性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around observation points, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary mirror placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mirror completeness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 比較「觀察點」與「鏡像完整性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Compare whether evidence for observation points and mirror completeness supports the same inference.
steps.failure: IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「觀察點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for observation points. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。
knowledge.textEn: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「鏡像完整性」：鏡像埠可能超載並丟包。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「觀察點」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring mirror completeness: Mirror ports can overload and drop packets. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove observation points passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 流中 200 異常；偵測 160、正常誤報 100，precision=160/260=61.54%、recall=80%。資料分布改變時這些比率亦改變。
knowledge.textEn: Among 100000 hypothetical flows with 200 anomalies, 160 detections and 100 false positives give precision=61.54% and recall=80%; distribution shifts change these values.

Principle: Estimate benign variability from representative data. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare flow summaries with complete synthetic protocol records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat anomaly versus incident as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Compare flow summaries with complete synthetic protocol records. Compare whether evidence for baseline models and anomaly versus incident supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 封包數沒有遺漏便保證應用解析完全正確。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較只有流量摘要與完整合成協議記錄。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 流中 200 異常；偵測 160、正常誤報 100，precision=160/260=61.54%、recall=80%。資料分布改變時這些比率亦改變。
knowledge.textEn: Among 100000 hypothetical flows with 200 anomalies, 160 detections and 100 false positives give precision=61.54% and recall=80%; distribution shifts change these values.

Estimate benign variability from representative data.
Checking anomaly versus incident alone replaces verification specific to baseline models.

options: IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。
只檢查「盲點報告」，便可取代「規則版本」的專屬驗證。
固定版本及設定才能重現判斷。
optionsEn: An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload.
Checking blind-spot reporting alone replaces verification specific to rule versions.
Pinned versions/configurations enable reproducible decisions.
quiz.explanation: 固定版本及設定才能重現判斷。 相鄰的「盲點報告」有不同責任：報告應列明未觀察區域而非聲稱全部防護。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。

steps.title: 規則版本：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Rule versions: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「規則版本」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For rule versions, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「固定版本及設定才能重現判斷。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬感測器丟包導致的證據缺口。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「盲點報告」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Pinned versions/configurations enable reproducible decisions. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from blind-spot reporting to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬感測器丟包導致的證據缺口。 比較「規則版本」與「盲點報告」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Compare whether evidence for rule versions and blind-spot reporting supports the same inference.
steps.failure: IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「規則版本」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rule versions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 盲點報告：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Blind-spot reporting: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「盲點報告」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For blind-spot reporting, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「盲點報告」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：報告應列明未觀察區域而非聲稱全部防護。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬感測器丟包導致的證據缺口。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「觀察點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around blind-spot reporting, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report unobserved regions rather than claiming complete protection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat observation points as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬感測器丟包導致的證據缺口。 比較「盲點報告」與「觀察點」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Compare whether evidence for blind-spot reporting and observation points supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 封包數沒有遺漏便保證應用解析完全正確。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Complete packet counts guarantee correct application parsing. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「盲點報告」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for blind-spot reporting. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 報告應列明未觀察區域而非聲稱全部防護。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「觀察點」：觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「盲點報告」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring observation points: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove blind-spot reporting passes.

knowledge.textEn: Model sensor packet loss and resulting evidence gaps. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 流中 200 異常；偵測 160、正常誤報 100，precision=160/260=61.54%、recall=80%。資料分布改變時這些比率亦改變。
knowledge.textEn: Among 100000 hypothetical flows with 200 anomalies, 160 detections and 100 false positives give precision=61.54% and recall=80%; distribution shifts change these values.

optionsEn: Report unobserved regions rather than claiming complete protection.
Complete packet counts guarantee correct application parsing.
Checking observation points alone replaces verification specific to blind-spot reporting.

quiz.explanationEn: Report unobserved regions rather than claiming complete protection. Neighboring observation points has a different role: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
courses.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

steps.title: 被動盤點：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「被動盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：被動觀察減少干擾，但可能漏掉離線資產。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留規則，只改維護例外期限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「協議限制」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix rules and vary maintenance-exception expiry. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protocol limitations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「本課使用流矩陣模擬，不掃描真實工控設備。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬隔離失效與預先定義的安全降階。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「OT 資產邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Evaluate the principle: This course simulates flow matrices without scanning live OT equipment. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from ot asset boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.check: 提交「離線驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for offline acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

courses.title: 物聯網裝置身分驗證
courses.summary: 以裝置根信任、佈建與憑據更新串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect device roots of trust, provisioning and credential renewal through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 裝置識別：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Device identifiers: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「裝置識別」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For device identifiers, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unique credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「裝置識別」與「唯一憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for device identifiers and unique credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 裝置各每日驗證一次，平均 1.1574 次/s；若全於 10 min 內集中，為 166.67 次/s，平均流量不足以規劃驗證尖峰。
knowledge.textEn: 100000 devices authenticating once/day average 1.1574/s; concentrating them into 10 minutes gives 166.67/s, so averages do not size authentication peaks.

stages.title: 介面、狀態與資源配置
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 秘密儲存：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Secret storage: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「秘密儲存」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For secret storage, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「秘密儲存」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：受保護儲存與應用讀取權限須分開。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「共同驗證」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around secret storage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Protected storage differs from application-read permissions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mutual authentication as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 比較「秘密儲存」與「共同驗證」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Compare whether evidence for secret storage and mutual authentication supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「秘密儲存」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for secret storage. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「時鐘限制」：低品質時鐘會影響有效期判讀。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「DTLS 邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring clock limitations: Poor clocks affect validity-window interpretation. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove dtls boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「DTLS 邊界」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of dtls boundaries?
options: 資料報安全仍需處理重排與重傳。
所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。
只檢查「時鐘限制」，便可取代「DTLS 邊界」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission.
One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free.
Checking clock limitations alone replaces verification specific to dtls boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 資料報安全仍需處理重排與重傳。 相鄰的「時鐘限制」有不同責任：低品質時鐘會影響有效期判讀。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission. Neighboring clock limitations has a different role: Poor clocks affect validity-window interpretation. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: DTLS 邊界：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: DTLS boundaries: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「DTLS 邊界」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For dtls boundaries, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「資料報安全仍需處理重排與重傳。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「時鐘限制」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Datagram security still handles reordering/retransmission. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from clock limitations to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 比較「DTLS 邊界」與「時鐘限制」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Compare whether evidence for dtls boundaries and clock limitations supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「DTLS 邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for dtls boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 時鐘限制：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Clock limitations: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘限制」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock limitations, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時鐘限制」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：低品質時鐘會影響有效期判讀。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「新鮮挑戰」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around clock limitations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Poor clocks affect validity-window interpretation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fresh challenges as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較有效與已撤銷的合成憑據。 比較「時鐘限制」與「新鮮挑戰」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare valid/revoked synthetic credentials. Compare whether evidence for clock limitations and fresh challenges supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 遠端證明可直接取代所有應用授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Remote attestation directly replaces every application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘限制」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock limitations. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 裝置各每日驗證一次，平均 1.1574 次/s；若全於 10 min 內集中，為 166.67 次/s，平均流量不足以規劃驗證尖峰。
knowledge.textEn: 100000 devices authenticating once/day average 1.1574/s; concentrating them into 10 minutes gives 166.67/s, so averages do not size authentication peaks.

quiz.explanationEn: Poor clocks affect validity-window interpretation. Neighboring fresh challenges has a different role: Challenge responses prove current participation, not replayed values. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

Principle: Renewal considers offline devices and dual-version transitions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary device-clock quality. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat revocation propagation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

更新需考慮離線裝置與雙版本過渡。

Renewal considers offline devices and dual-version transitions.

courses.title: 車用網路安全監測
courses.summary: 以車載訊息、被動觀測與安全責任串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect vehicle messages, passive observation and safety responsibility through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 車載功能圖：架構與原理

steps.objective: 針對「車載功能圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For vehicle function maps, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「車載功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：動力、車身與資訊娛樂具不同風險與時限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定訊框，只改時間間隔模式。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「訊息識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Powertrain, body and infotainment have different risks/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frames and vary interarrival patterns. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat message identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Fix frames and vary interarrival patterns. Compare whether evidence for vehicle function maps and message identifiers supports the same inference.

steps.check: 提交「車載功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for vehicle function maps. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring value ranges: Out-of-range values differ from implausible change rates. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove periodic baselines passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「週期基線」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of periodic baselines?
options: 看到 CAN ID 就能證明發送裝置身分。
正常週期會隨驾驶與模式變化。
只檢查「數值範圍」，便可取代「週期基線」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: A CAN ID proves the transmitting device identity.
Normal periods change with driving/operational modes.
Checking value ranges alone replaces verification specific to periodic baselines.
quiz.explanation: 正常週期會隨驾驶與模式變化。 相鄰的「數值範圍」有不同責任：超範圍與不合物理變化率是不同證據。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal periods change with driving/operational modes. Neighboring value ranges has a different role: Out-of-range values differ from implausible change rates. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 週期基線：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Periodic baselines: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「週期基線」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For periodic baselines, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「正常週期會隨驾驶與模式變化。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「數值範圍」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Normal periods change with driving/operational modes. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from value ranges to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 比較「週期基線」與「數值範圍」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Compare whether evidence for periodic baselines and value ranges supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 看到 CAN ID 就能證明發送裝置身分。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A CAN ID proves the transmitting device identity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「週期基線」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for periodic baselines. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 數值範圍：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Value ranges: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「數值範圍」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For value ranges, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「數值範圍」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：超範圍與不合物理變化率是不同證據。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「跨信號關系」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around value ranges, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Out-of-range values differ from implausible change rates. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cross-signal relations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較正常診斷與未批准診斷的合成事件。 比較「數值範圍」與「跨信號關系」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare authorized/unauthorized synthetic diagnostic events. Compare whether evidence for value ranges and cross-signal relations supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 資安監測可取代全部功能安全驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Cybersecurity monitoring replaces all functional-safety validation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「數值範圍」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.objective: 針對「告警延遲」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For alert latency, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「告警延遲應低於情境需要而非只看平均。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留規則，只改匯流排負載。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「誤報處置」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Alert delay should satisfy context, not only average performance. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix rules and vary bus load. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from false-alert handling to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留規則，只改匯流排負載。 比較「告警延遲」與「誤報處置」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix rules and vary bus load. Compare whether evidence for alert latency and false-alert handling supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 資安監測可取代全部功能安全驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Cybersecurity monitoring replaces all functional-safety validation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「告警延遲」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for alert latency. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 告警延遲應低於情境需要而非只看平均。
knowledge.textEn: Alert delay should satisfy context, not only average performance.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「誤報處置」：錯誤阻斷可能影響安全，回應須经設計審查。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「告警延遲」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring false-alert handling: False blocking can affect safety; review responses formally. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove alert latency passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留規則，只改匯流排負載。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix rules and vary bus load. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「告警延遲」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of alert latency?
options: 資安監測可取代全部功能安全驗證。
只檢查「誤報處置」，便可取代「告警延遲」的專屬驗證。
告警延遲應低於情境需要而非只看平均。
optionsEn: Cybersecurity monitoring replaces all functional-safety validation.
Checking false-alert handling alone replaces verification specific to alert latency.
Alert delay should satisfy context, not only average performance.
quiz.explanation: 告警延遲應低於情境需要而非只看平均。 相鄰的「誤報處置」有不同責任：錯誤阻斷可能影響安全，回應須经設計審查。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Alert delay should satisfy context, not only average performance. Neighboring false-alert handling has a different role: False blocking can affect safety; review responses formally. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

stages.title: 效能、復原與證據交接
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 誤報處置：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: False-alert handling: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「誤報處置」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For false-alert handling, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「誤報處置」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：錯誤阻斷可能影響安全，回應須经設計審查。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬監測器失效對告警覆蓋的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「安全責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around false-alert handling, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: False blocking can affect safety; review responses formally. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat safety responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬監測器失效對告警覆蓋的影響。 比較「誤報處置」與「安全責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model monitor failure and alert-coverage effects. Compare whether evidence for false-alert handling and safety responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 看到 CAN ID 就能證明發送裝置身分。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A CAN ID proves the transmitting device identity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「誤報處置」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for false-alert handling. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 威胁模型：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Threat models: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「威胁模型」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For threat models, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「威胁模型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「保護邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around threat models, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protection boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「威胁模型」與「保護邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for threat models and protection boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「威胁模型」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for threat models. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。
knowledge.textEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「保護邊界」：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「威胁模型」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring protection boundaries: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove threat models passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想證明 15 ms、驗證 5 ms、秘密傳送 10 ms，串行初始化合 30 ms；若每秒 100 次初始作業且不可並行，每秒需 3 s 處理，單通道不足。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed attestation=15 ms, verification=5 ms and secret transfer=10 ms give 30 ms serial initialization; 100 starts/s require 3 processing-seconds/s, exceeding one serial channel.

quiz.question: 針對「威胁模型」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of threat models?
options: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。
機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。
只檢查「保護邊界」，便可取代「威胁模型」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first.
Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug.
Checking protection boundaries alone replaces verification specific to threat models.
quiz.explanation: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 相鄰的「保護邊界」有不同責任：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Neighboring protection boundaries has a different role: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 威胁模型：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Threat models: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「威胁模型」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For threat models, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「保護邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from protection boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for threat models and protection boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「威胁模型」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

只檢查「受測工作負載」，便可取代「記憶體加密」的專屬驗證。
加密與完整性保護是不同性質。
optionsEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug.
Checking measured workloads alone replaces verification specific to memory encryption.
Encryption and integrity protection are distinct properties.

steps.title: 記憶體加密：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Memory encryption: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「記憶體加密」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For memory encryption, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「加密與完整性保護是不同性質。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「受測工作負載」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Encryption and integrity protection are distinct properties. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from measured workloads to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「記憶體加密」與「受測工作負載」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for memory encryption and measured workloads supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「記憶體加密」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for memory encryption. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「受測工作負載」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Attester」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat attesters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.check: 提交「受測工作負載」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.title: 部署驗收：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Deployment acceptance: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「部署驗收」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For deployment acceptance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「部署驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 host 攻击面之外的應用授權缺陷。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「威胁模型」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around deployment acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat threat models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Compare whether evidence for deployment acceptance and threat models supports the same inference.

steps.objectiveEn: For deployment acceptance, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬 host 攻击面之外的應用授權缺陷。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「威胁模型」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

related.title: TLS 憑證自動化
related.why: 可移植「樹狀命名空間」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from hierarchical namespace; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「樹狀命名空間」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
